main_text.l: Symbolo tempore, de Photio auctore Schis-
matis, de Schismatis renouatione. An Pho-
sibi arrogantis causa fuerit: An quod ad-
iudicio, non vero particularis alicuius Epi-
scopi auctoritate facta fuerit, & de aucto-
rum, & de scriptis Photij combustis, nos
Schismaticis, uti ex veris fontibus in hac
ftrum Syropulum, vel ut vult eo stultior,
in noftris aduersus dicti Creygthoni Hifto-
propediem edendis. Quare hic plura dice-

l.i: Ut non videas, qua fronte tantus vir ea, quae
nunc extruit, nunc rursus deftruat, & convel-lat.

page.notes: Printed hyphens kept at line ends. Possibly misprinted or unclear: "connel-" in the last paragraph, read as convel- (u/v rule applied); "Sgropulum" and "Creyghtonus" as printed. "Creygthono" and "Creygthoni" are spelled as printed. Left margin and right edge show only stains.
